explication: Fluent Bit is a telemetry agent that collects logs, metrics, and traces, processes them through a pluggable pipeline, and forwards them to destinations. The principal workflow is source/input plugins → processing and filters → output plugins; the engine is the internal runtime layer coordinating that workflow. The README also documents SQL stream processing, HTTP/Prometheus monitoring, secure networking, and C/Lua/Go extensibility. Several subsystem paths are based on the repository tree and README rather than inspected implementation; relationships not explicitly documented are omitted.
